source.notes: ICSE Std. IX school half-yearly mathematics paper (school not named). Header prints 'Half Yearly Examination 2017-2018', 'Std. : IX', 'Subject : MATHEMATICS', 'Full Marks : 80', 'Time : 2½ Hrs+15mins.'; examYear 2018 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). durationMinutes 165 = 2½ h + 15 min as printed. Section A [40 marks] (Questions 1-4, attempt all); Section B (Questions 5-11, attempt any four), so the pack's marks total exceeds 80. Q1(c) prints '[2x20]', which cannot be a real mark (likely a misprint), and Q11(a) has no mark printed; both carry marks 0 as a placeholder and are flagged LOW. The file is a typeset document scanned/rasterised without a text layer; figures are not reproduced, simple data tables are transcribed. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
